facts.fact: 一个笨重的 gendarme 咆哮着指控 Chambely 秘密约见那女孩；Chambely 在血泊中以为 Julietta 死了，攥紧口袋里那枚 promise-ring；被翻正的尸体却是另一个深发女子，不是 Julietta
facts.anchor: and lovely even in death—but it was not his Julietta.

facts.fact: Moyna 的父母只教过她两件事：别引起 gendarmerie 注意，也别费劲跟他们争辩；Apprice 家想在 Sieuxerr 尽量顺滑地生活，好在动身去 Camar 时也能顺利脱身
facts.anchor: Her parents had told her exactly two things: Don’t attract their attention

facts.fact: Thoury 提出职位，说单是三个 Resée 城市就有 gendarmerie 愿为能审问谋杀受害者的人付可观合同费；Moyna 想象自己像图书馆的书被借到世界各地
facts.anchor: three Resée cities alone whose gendarmerie would pay a handsome contract fee

facts.fact: Moyna 说她不能立刻接受 Thoury 的职位，除非他能让与 Greteford 的 Academie 合同消失；她没告诉他，五年后丢下父母回 Sieuxerr 会被永远当成丢人的胡闹和失望
facts.anchor: unless he could wave a hand and make her Academie contract with Greteford disappear

facts.fact: Moyna 请 Thoury 在考试时到 Teaching Theatre；Thoury 说他一定到场，因为 Marcelle 一家在等他，他不想让他们失望
facts.anchor: The Marcelles are expecting me. I’d hate to disappoint them.

facts.fact: artificers 对雇佣条件与被低估不满，本同意把总罢工推迟到下周以免影响 Grand Exam，但计划在最后一天最后时段只扰乱一组：让 Rondelle 的一间 chamber 不可用，逼该组改用他们辛苦布置好的 Teaching Theatre；他们会提前通知 Secretary
facts.anchor: stepping in and making their chamber of the Rondelle inaccessible

facts.fact: Jehan 迟迟不到；Estiene 说从凌晨两点后就没见过他，回宿舍说服 hallmaster 开门，发现床没睡过、桌上只有几支铅笔和一张 Guion Blavot 的便条；Estiene 解释 Jehan 偷 Academie 东西、被 Blavot 勒索为拳手做非法强化，又说漏自己要离开 Sieuxerr，而便条要他 Lantern Night 到场
facts.anchor: He held up a small piece of densely creased paper. “A note from Guion Blavot.”

facts.fact: Adala 建议若找到 Jehan 就报 gendarmerie；Estiene 拒绝，因为 Committee for Healer Workforce 会因 Jehan 的罪行把他契约绑定多年、再卖给出价最高者；随后他说自己有主意
facts.anchor: they bond him for years as punishment, and sell him to the highest bidder!
